title: Central disk: remove stale worktrees and build targets under the TermAl checkout (52 GiB free, full-gate floor 50 GiB)
outcome: Central has comfortable headroom above the full-gate disk floor, because worktrees and build targets that no open item or live session needs are removed. Nothing in use is touched.
acceptance: A census lists the TermAl checkout's git worktrees and .tmp/ directories (including target/ build directories) with their sizes and owning item or session, and classifies each as in use (open claim, live session workdir, running test, frozen candidate or retention note) or removable (its items closed or landed, no live session, no retention note).

Only removable entries are deleted, each after resolving its absolute path and checking that it lies inside C:\github\Personal\TermAl, with git worktree remove (or git worktree prune for already-missing ones) used for registered worktrees; no live worktree, running test or frozen candidate is touched, and nothing outside the repository is deleted.
Free space on the TermAl volume before and after is recorded on this item, with the list of removed paths.
